function isSSL(){
    if( !empty( $_SERVER['HTTPS'] ) AND $_SERVER['HTTPS'] != 'off')
        return true;

    if( !empty( $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] ) && $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] == 'https' )
        return true;

    return false;
}
$bb_cfg['cookie_secure'] = (isSSL()) ? 1 : 0);
